settings.visualStyle: Eastern Front 1941 historical reenactment, embedded field-camera perspective, vast rural scale, mud, dust, damaged villages, long roads and changing weather. Muted 35mm wartime color, realistic period equipment, non-graphic combat, no modern objects, no propaganda framing.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 connected scenes x 8 seconds. Follow one fictional composite infantryman as a continuity anchor through road movement, village approach, roadside contact, open-ground movement, artillery support, short rest and continued advance. No dialogue or narrator. One primary action and one camera movement per scene.
settings.customVisualStyle: Wide Eastern European landscapes contrasted with close human details: muddy boots, overloaded packs, truck wheels, burnt timber, wind over open fields and distant smoke columns.

movie.plotDetails: A fictional composite soldier serves as a visual continuity anchor within a broad 1941 Eastern Front environment.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create a two-minute embedded-war-camera reenactment of the Eastern Front in 1941. The story should communicate enormous distance, difficult roads, burning settlements, sudden contact and the exhaustion of repeated movement. Use one fictional infantryman as the continuity anchor. Avoid triumphal staging, constant explosions and graphic injury. No dialogue and no narration. Make the landscape itself a major character.
movie.storySummary: An infantry column moves east across a vast landscape. Mud slows vehicles, smoke marks a village ahead, and a sudden roadside firefight forces the troops into a ditch. After crossing open ground with artillery support, the section passes through the damaged village, pauses briefly at a well, and returns to the road beneath a threatening sky. The final image shows the column becoming tiny against the endless landscape.
movie.storyTitle: WWII FRONTLINE FOOTAGE EP03 — Eastern Front 1941: Into the Vast Land

scenes.title: Endless Road
scenes.description: A muddy track runs toward an enormous horizon beneath a high overcast sky.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman walks beside a slow truck convoy while wind moves the roadside grass.
scenes.imageDescription: Eastern Front 1941, vast open fields, muddy road, infantry and trucks stretching into distance, same rifleman with heavy pack and muddy boots, restrained wartime film grain.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow side tracking shot with the road dominating depth. Audio: truck engines, boots, wind, gear, no speech.

scenes.title: Wheel in the Mud
scenes.description: A truck wheel sinks into deep mud and briefly stalls the column.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman steps aside as soldiers push near the rear of the stuck vehicle.
scenes.imageDescription: Close muddy wheel, splashed trousers, boots sinking in ruts, period truck, open field background.
scenes.videoPrompt: Start low on spinning wheel then tilt to men pushing. Audio: engine strain, mud suction, boots, metal creak.

scenes.title: Village Smoke
scenes.description: Dark smoke rises beyond a cluster of wooden houses ahead.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman slows with the section and studies the village from the road edge.
scenes.imageDescription: Wooden Eastern European village ahead, fences, smoke, muddy approach road, troops paused under grey sky.
scenes.videoPrompt: Pan from the rifleman across fence lines to smoke above the village. Audio: wind, distant rumble, engines idling.

scenes.title: Quiet Lane
scenes.description: The first village lane appears nearly empty but damaged.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman walks cautiously past a broken cart and smoke-stained fence.
scenes.imageDescription: Wooden houses, damaged cart, fences, smoke and scattered debris, same soldier scanning doorways, no civilians visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow shoulder-height handheld sweep along the lane. Audio: boots, loose timber, wind, distant fire.

scenes.title: Fire Across the Road
scenes.description: Incoming rounds crack across the road from farther ahead.
scenes.actionDescription: The squad drops into a shallow drainage ditch as dust kicks from the road surface.
scenes.imageDescription: Shallow roadside ditch, dirt road, infantry dropping low, dust impacts, non-graphic combat.
scenes.videoPrompt: Abrupt handheld fall into ditch level. Audio: sharp cracks, dirt impacts, hard breathing, no words.

scenes.title: Ditch Line
scenes.description: The section returns controlled fire from the low roadside cover.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman rises just enough over the ditch lip to fire before lowering again.
scenes.imageDescription: Low ditch firing position, open farmland beyond, same soldier with mud on sleeves and helmet, smoke drifting in wind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low over-shoulder shot; brief firing sequence only. Audio: rifle reports, echoes, wind, distant engine.

scenes.title: Across Open Ground
scenes.description: A small group moves from the ditch toward a low field embankment.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman sprints across uneven ground and drops behind the embankment.
scenes.imageDescription: Wide open field, low vegetation, smoke in distance, soldiers running with space between them.
scenes.videoPrompt: One short human-weight run ending low behind cover. Audio: boots, breathing, distant gunfire.

scenes.title: Artillery Far Ahead
scenes.description: Supporting shells land well beyond the section near the next rise.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman stays low and watches distant impacts through drifting smoke.
scenes.imageDescription: Field embankment foreground, distant artillery impacts near horizon, soldier low and observant, no close explosion.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow pan from soldier to distant impact line. Audio: delayed artillery booms, wind, breathing.

scenes.title: Through Burnt Fences
scenes.description: The section advances through the far side of the damaged village.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman steps around charred fence posts and broken timber.
scenes.imageDescription: Burned fence line, damaged wooden buildings, hanging smoke, tired infantry moving carefully.
scenes.videoPrompt: Walking handheld shot weaving through fence gaps. Audio: boots, crackling embers, distant battle.

scenes.title: The Village Well
scenes.description: A brief lull gathers several soldiers around an old well.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman drinks quickly from his canteen while resting one hand on the well edge.
scenes.imageDescription: Old rural well, damaged village background, soldier drinking with rifle resting low, no combat nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Gentle close push-in. Audio: canteen, swallowing, wind, distant guns with long gaps.

scenes.title: Column Reforms
scenes.description: Vehicles and infantry begin moving again along the mud track.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman shoulders his pack and rejoins the moving line.
scenes.imageDescription: Same muddy road now churned deeper, trucks and infantry restarting, soldier dirtier than earlier.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear tracking shot as the line reforms. Audio: boots, engines, gear, wind.

scenes.title: Storm Front
scenes.description: Dark weather builds over the plain as the march continues.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman keeps walking while gusts pull at his coat and grass bends toward the road.
scenes.imageDescription: Wide Eastern European plain beneath darkening storm clouds, tiny marching column and trucks, windblown grass.
scenes.videoPrompt: Tilt from muddy boots to the huge storm sky. Audio: stronger wind, engines, distant thunder-like artillery.

scenes.title: Beyond the Next Rise
scenes.description: The column crests a low rise and discovers even more open country.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman reaches the crest and briefly stops at the expanded view.
scenes.imageDescription: Low rise opening to enormous fields, long road and distant smoke, soldier foreground small against landscape.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cresting reveal from grass foreground to broad landscape. Audio: wind, distant engines and artillery.

scenes.title: Smoke Behind
scenes.description: The soldier glances back at the village now far behind the moving column.
scenes.actionDescription: He turns once toward the smoke behind, then faces forward again.
scenes.imageDescription: Road with distant village smoke behind and open landscape ahead, same tired soldier mid-turn.
scenes.videoPrompt: One half-turn camera move with the soldier, ending forward. Audio: boots, wind, distant rumble.

scenes.title: Into the East
scenes.description: The column becomes smaller and smaller against the vast road and sky.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier disappears into the marching line as the camera remains behind.
scenes.imageDescription: Long muddy road, receding infantry and trucks, enormous sky, several faint smoke columns, subdued 1941 field-film aesthetic.
scenes.videoPrompt: Long static-to-gentle handheld closing hold as the column recedes. Audio: fading engines, boots, wind, low restrained score tail.

characters.name: Advance Column Rifleman
characters.description: Anonymous 1941 infantry rifleman in historically plausible field gear, muddy boots, steel helmet and heavy pack.

continuity.continuityRules: Keep face, helmet, rifle and pack consistent. Mud and fatigue increase through the episode; no cross-faction equipment.

props.personalProps: period rifle, helmet, heavy pack, canteen
